evals.prompt: Review this AntD form email field. It renders `` followed by `{msg}` for the message. The input has no `aria-invalid` and no `aria-describedby`, and the error is not the DS ``.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C2 — wrong/hand-rolled field-error component in an AntD form and missing aria wiring.
evals.expected_output: C2 (Correct field-error variant, wired to its input) FAILs: this form field uses a hand-rolled `<span className="err">` instead of the DS `<aha-field-error>` (the default form variant), and the input is missing `aria-invalid` plus an `aria-describedby` pointing at the error's `id`. Fix: render `<aha-field-error id="email-err" message={msg}>` and set `aria-invalid={!!msg}` + `aria-describedby="email-err"` on the input (a DS `<aha-input>` forwards both to its inner field). Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Evidence notes hand-rolled span and missing aria-invalid/aria-describedby
Fix says use <aha-field-error> with aria-invalid and aria-describedby wired to its id

evals.prompt: Review this responsive table. It swaps a table for a card list on mobile via `const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 600px)');`, and its toolbar styling uses `@media (max-width: 768px) { .toolbar { gap: 8px; } }`.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3 — ad-hoc breakpoint for a shape switch + wrong media-query value (768px not 767.98px).
evals.expected_output: C3 (Responsive shape switches use useIsMobile(); pure styling uses the media query) FAILs: the table->card-list shape switch is gated on an ad-hoc `useMediaQuery('(max-width: 600px)')` instead of `useIsMobile()`, and the pure-styling media query uses `768px` instead of the canonical `767.98px` (which avoids the sub-pixel gap at fractional DPR). Fix: gate the shape switch on `useIsMobile()` and change the media query to `@media (max-width: 767.98px)`. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Evidence cites the ad-hoc useMediaQuery breakpoint and the 768px media query

evals.prompt:
Review this live region and skeleton. The announcement renders `{msg &&
{msg}
}` (unmounts when empty, has role=alert, no aria-atomic) and the loading placeholder is `

evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C4 — live region unmounts empty/has role=alert/no aria-atomic; skeleton missing role=status+aria-busy.
evals.expected_output: C4 (Accessibility house rules honoured) FAILs: the live region unmounts when `msg` is empty (screen readers lose track), carries a `role="alert"` (double-announce with aria-live), and is missing `aria-atomic="true"`; the skeleton container is missing `role="status"` and `aria-busy`. Fix: use `<aha-live-region>`, which stays mounted, is assertive + atomic and has no `role="alert"`, and give the skeleton container `role="status"` + `aria-busy`. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Evidence notes the live region unmounts empty, has role=alert, and lacks aria-atomic
Fix says keep it mounted, assertive+atomic, no role=alert, and add role=status+aria-busy to the skeleton

evals.prompt: Self-check this respondent quiz screen. Announcements use `<aha-live-region message={announcement}>` (always mounted); progress uses `<aha-progressbar value={n} min={0} max={total} label={t('quiz.progress')}>`; the inline answer error uses `<aha-field-error id="q3-err" variant="respondent" message={error}>` with the input carrying `aria-invalid={!!error}` and `aria-describedby="q3-err"`; the mobile layout swap is gated on `useIsMobile()` while toolbar styling uses `@media (max-width: 767.98px)`; the loading placeholder is a layout-mirroring set of `<aha-skeleton>` inside a container with `role="status"` + `aria-busy`; and all visible text is DS / Typography text.
evals.label: good-control
evals.notes: Good control (respondent context) — all primitives reused, correct FieldErrorDisplay, canonical breakpoint, a11y contracts intact.
evals.expected_output: All 4 criteria PASS. C1: <aha-live-region>, <aha-progressbar>, <aha-field-error> and a layout-mirroring <aha-skeleton> are the canonical DS primitives, nothing hand-rolled. C2: variant="respondent" is the right field-error variant for a respondent renderer, with aria-invalid + aria-describedby wired to its id. C3: shape switch on useIsMobile(), styling at the canonical 767.98px. C4: the live region stays mounted (assertive + atomic, no role=alert), the progressbar carries role/aria-value*/aria-label, the skeleton container has role=status + aria-busy, text is DS / Typography. Overall verdict: OK TO SHIP.
assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP
All of C1 through C4 are marked PASS
C2 confirms variant="respondent" is correct for a respondent renderer with aria wiring
C4 confirms the live region stays mounted, assertive+atomic, no role=alert

evals.prompt:
Review this dashboard's not-found route. It returns `

404

We couldn't find that page.

` with its own centred layout CSS.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C1 — hand-rolled full-page error instead of <aha-error-page>.
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: a full-page error is a hand-built `<div className="not-found">` instead of the DS `<aha-error-page>`, so it loses the shared Result layout, British-English default copy, role="alert" and the error-page-view telemetry. evals.prompt: Review this respondent poll element renderer. When the respondent submits without picking an option it renders `<aha-field-error id="poll-err" message="Pick at least one option">` (no `variant`), and the option group carries `aria-invalid="true"` + `aria-describedby="poll-err"`.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C2 — right primitive, right wiring, wrong variant; guards against over-firing on the wiring.
evals.expected_output: C2 FAILs: the wiring is right, but a respondent element renderer needs `variant="respondent"` (the FieldErrorDisplay contract: role=alert, assertive) — the default form variant is announced politely and can be missed mid-answer. Fix: `<aha-field-error id="poll-err" variant="respondent" message="Pick at least one option">`. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Flags the missing variant="respondent" on a respondent renderer
Does not flag the aria-invalid / aria-describedby wiring, which is correct

evals.notes: Targets C3 — the HTML path (no React hook) of the shape switch.

Fix: put the two layouts in `<aha-viewport-switch>` with `slot="mobile"` and `slot="desktop"`. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
